terms.intro: These terms apply when you book a ride with EU Limousine through our website.

p: EU Limousine is operated by [Company legal name], CVR [CVR number], [Street, postcode, city], Denmark.
Contact: [email address] · [phone number].
We provide pre-booked chauffeur transport with a professional driver, mainly in [service area, e.g. Copenhagen and Copenhagen Airport].
The vehicle class you book (for example Business Class) guarantees the class and number of seats, not a specific make or model.
The price shown before payment is the fixed price for the trip as you booked it (route, time, vehicle class and passengers).
You pay the full price when you book, through [payment provider]. We do not store your card details.
After payment you receive an email that your booking has been received. When a chauffeur has been assigned, you receive a second email with the chauffeur's name, phone number and vehicle.
The price includes [VAT / tolls / bridge fees / parking — to be confirmed].
Extra stops, extra waiting time or route changes requested during the trip are [charged as follows / not possible — to be decided].
To change the time, address or vehicle class, contact us at [email/phone] at least [X hours] before pickup. A change may change the price.
Our cancellation policy explains when you can cancel and what is refunded.
Your chauffeur waits [X minutes] free of charge at the pickup address, or [Y minutes] after landing for airport pickups.
If the passenger does not show up and cannot be reached within the waiting time, the booking counts as a no-show: [no-show policy].
If you give us your flight number, we [follow the flight and adjust the pickup time to the actual landing time — to be confirmed].
Each vehicle class has a maximum number of passengers and luggage, shown when you book. The chauffeur may refuse more passengers or luggage than the vehicle can safely carry.
[Rules on child seats, pets, smoking, food and drink — to be decided.]
[Liability terms — to be written by a lawyer.]
We are not responsible for delays caused by circumstances outside our control, such as [accidents, severe weather, road closures].
Please send complaints to [email address]. We answer within [X working days].
[Consumer complaint body and process — to be confirmed by a lawyer.]
These terms are governed by Danish law. [Venue for disputes — to be confirmed.]

cancellation.intro: This policy explains how to cancel a booking and what is refunded. Refunds are always made by our staff; nothing is refunded automatically.

p: Contact us at [email/phone] with your booking reference (for example EUL-ABC234).
Cancelled more than [X hours] before pickup: [full refund].
Cancelled between [X] and [Y hours] before pickup: [refund amount or percentage].
Cancelled less than [Y hours] before pickup, or no-show: [refund rule].
Refunds go back to the payment method you used, normally within [X days], depending on [payment provider] and your bank.
If we have to cancel your booking, you get a full refund. [Any further compensation — to be decided.]

privacy.intro: This policy explains which personal data we collect when you book with EU Limousine, why, and your rights under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

p: [Company legal name], CVR [CVR number], [address]. Contact for privacy questions: [email address].
Booking details: pickup and drop-off addresses, date and time, number of passengers, flight number and notes if you give them.
Contact details: your name, email address and phone number, and the passenger's name and phone if you book for someone else.
Payment: the amount, status and a reference from our payment provider. We never receive or store your card details.
Technical data: your language choice and basic server logs needed to run and protect the website.
To carry out your booking, send you emails about it and let the chauffeur contact the passenger (contract, GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)).
To keep accounting records required by law (legal obligation, Art. 6(1)(c)).
To protect the website against abuse (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f)).
The chauffeur assigned to your ride: passenger name, phone number, addresses, time, flight number and notes.
Our payment provider: [name].
Our email provider: [name].
Our hosting provider: Google Cloud (servers in the EU, region europe-west1, Belgium).
[Any other processors — to be listed.] We do not sell your data.
[Whether any provider transfers data outside the EU/EEA, and the safeguards used — to be confirmed.]
Booking and accounting records: [5 years after the end of the financial year, as required by the Danish Bookkeeping Act — to be confirmed].
Other data: [retention period].
You can ask for access to your data, correction, deletion, restriction, data portability, and object to processing based on legitimate interest. Contact [email address].
You can complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency (Datatilsynet), www.datatilsynet.dk.
Data is sent over encrypted connections (HTTPS). Access is limited to staff who need it, and changes are logged.

cookies.intro: We keep cookies and similar storage to a minimum. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

p: NEXT_LOCALE (cookie): remembers your language choice. Kept for 1 year.

Booking in progress (session storage in your browser): keeps the details of a booking you are making, so a reload or language change does not lose them. Deleted when you close the tab or complete the booking.
Security check [Cloudflare Turnstile]: protects the booking form against automated abuse. [Confirm what it stores.]
The payment page is run by [payment provider] under its own cookie policy.
We do not use analytics at the moment. If we add analytics, we will ask for your consent first.
You can delete cookies in your browser settings. The website still works, but your language choice is forgotten.

items.a: Use Book a ride: enter your journey, choose a vehicle, add your details and pay. It takes a few minutes.

items.q: Can I book for someone else?
items.a: Yes. Tick "I am booking for someone else" and add the passenger's name and phone.

items.q: How far in advance must I book?
items.a: The booking form shows the earliest pickup time you can choose.

items.q: Which languages can I book in?
items.a: English, Danish, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Romansh. Use the language menu at the top.
From the route between pickup and destination, the vehicle class and the number of passengers. You see the fixed price before you pay.
No. The price is for the whole vehicle and journey.

items.q: Which currencies can I pay in?
items.a: Choose DKK, EUR or USD in the booking form, where available for your vehicle.

items.q: Should I add my flight number?
items.a: Yes. It is added to your booking so your chauffeur knows which flight you arrive on.

items.q: How do I find my chauffeur?
items.a: You receive your chauffeur's name and phone by email once a chauffeur is assigned.

items.q: How do I change my booking?
items.a: Contact us with your booking reference and the change you need.
Yes. The conditions are described in our cancellation policy. Contact us with your booking reference.
